           LINARIA VULGARIS

         Toad-flax-Snap Dragon

        (LINARIA)


Acts prominently within the domain of the pneumogastrics. Eructations,
        nausea, salivation, pressure on stomach. Jaundice, splenic and hepatic hypertrophy. Enteric
        symptoms and   great drowsiness   very marked. Cardiac   fainting  . Enuresis. Rectal symptoms. Tongue rough, dry; throat
        constricted. Coldness. Confusion in head. Irresistible sleepiness. Symptoms worse walking in
        open air.



Dose.--  Third potency.
